Bright 3 bedroom, 1.5 bath flat near Packard and Stadium — Example listing (fictional).
Rent is $2,050 a month for the whole apartment.
Heat and water are included; tenants pay electric and internet.
Coin laundry in the basement.
Free driveway parking for one car.
Sorry, no pets.
Window A/C units in every bedroom.
Available Aug 15, 2027 on a 12-month lease.
Application fee $45 per adult; security deposit $2,050.
Contact owner at owner.example@example.com or 734-555-0142.
